title: Jump server and controlled administrative access

videos.script: The way an administrator reaches a server ends at root. It is the most valuable path on the network. {{doors}} In the lab, every machine can reach every server. A key stolen from any of them works everywhere. {{jump}} This lesson builds one door. A jump server that does nothing else, and that you pass through rather than work on. {{close}} Then the servers refuse everybody else, so the door is the only way. {{cert}} Then the keys stop being permanent. Each one is a certificate that expires within the hour. {{log}} And the door writes down who came through, by name, so a login is never just somebody.
